messages.cli.help.exec:
mint exec - Explicit policy execution

For automation and advanced diagnostics. Use init, run, resume, or status for normal tasks.

Usage:
  {program} exec [options] task
  {program} exec --resume --session path [options]

Input and state:
  --root path               Project root
  --config path             Model configuration
  --policy path             Explicit task policy
  --session path            Checkpoint file
  --events-jsonl path       Event log file
  --resume                  Resume a checkpoint
  --retry-inflight          Retry an unconfirmed side-effecting tool
  --json                    Emit machine-readable JSON
  --lang language           UI language: en or zh-CN

Capabilities:
  --allow-write             Allow text writes
  --allow-write-path path   Limit write scope; repeatable
  --allow-command program   Allow an executable without a shell; repeatable
  --require-verification    Require a verification command after changes
  --approve-each-command    Confirm before every command
  --approve-each-changeset  Confirm before every multi-file change
  --unsafe-no-command-sandbox  Disable the command OS sandbox

Budgets:
  --max-turns count         {min_turns} to {max_turns}
  --max-seconds seconds     1 to {max_seconds}
  --max-context-bytes bytes {min_context_bytes} to {max_context_bytes}
  --max-total-tokens count  0 (disabled) to {max_total_tokens}
messages.cli.help.general:
mint - Lightweight General AI Agent

Usage:
  {program} init [--root path] [--state-dir path] [--force] [--json]
  {program} run [--root path] [--state-dir path] [--config path] [--demo] [task]
  {program} resume [--root path] [--state-dir path] [--task ID] [--config path]
  {program} status [--root path] [--state-dir path] [--task ID] [--json]

Model configuration:
  {program} provider [--config path] [--json]  Inspect provider capabilities offline
  {program} provider test [--config path] [--json]  Run a two-turn live compatibility test

Advanced execution:
  {program} exec --help  Configure capabilities, policy, and event files explicitly

Common options:
  --root path          Project directory; defaults to the current directory
  --state-dir path     Override the local state directory outside the workspace
  --config path        Model configuration; defaults to ./config.json
  --task ID            Resume or inspect a specific task
  --demo               Run offline without calling a model
  --json               Emit machine-readable JSON
  --lang language      UI language: en or zh-CN
  --log-level level    Terminal log level; defaults to warn
  --log-file-level level  File log level; off disables file logging
  --version            Show the version
  -h, --help           Show help
